desktop.disclosure: The AI actions (AI add, Summarize page, Extract chapter characters, and Generate image) send page content through the desktop client to your selected AI provider. When a novel has no context yet, the first AI action also asks the provider to research the novel on the web. Image generation uses Codex. Connecting also shares your Story Lens sign-in with the desktop client so its wiki crawler can read and save your novels' characters; signing out removes it.

desktop.imagePromptHelp: How character images are drawn. Story Lens adds the passages of the current chapter that mention the character, its name, aliases, description and category, then the novel context, and Codex generates one image that uploads to image storage when you save the form.
